name: ConnectiCon
blurb: Connecticut's longest-running pop-culture convention, with anime, video and tabletop gaming, cosplay and celebrity guests in Hartford.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'CONNECTICON XXIV JULY 15 - 18, 2027 HARTFORD, CT' with a live countdown (283 days remaining as measured on 2026-10-05, consistent with a July 15, 2027 start)

notes: This is ConnectiCon XXIV (the con's own text also says '23rd year' in a leftover sentence -- numbering inconsistency on their own site). The /guests page (261 image candidates) is explicitly headed 'Previous Guests' and every name sits under that one section, i.e. it is a historical talent wall covering many past years, not an announced XXIV lineup, so no names were picked from it; a follow-up check of the 'Guest Appearances' schedule view (/events#category/Guests) rendered only the generic site shell with no guest cards either. guests is therefore 'none-yet'. Venue not recorded: the rendered page only said 'Convention Center' / 'Marriott' without the full official venue name. Cover uses the widest current hero banner (hero:0, 1366x691); a narrower, explicitly-labeled '2027 Announcement' slide (hero:3, portrait) was the only image tying art directly to 2027 but didn't meet the wide-banner preference. Organizer company name not found on-site.
